title: Settlement Sheet of the Equity Desk: The Equity an Estate Receives on a Membership and Patronage Equity Account
content:
**The equity standing.** The equity standing is the equity portions credited on the membership's allocation notices plus its capital retains, nothing being taken off for revolvement, rounded to two decimal places.

**The discount.** Equity retired to an estate carries the class's own estate retirement discount, as the class schedule of Membership and Patronage Equity carries it.

**The dividend.** No dividend arrears are carried on the settlement.

**What is taken off.** Nothing is taken off for what the member owed the cooperative, and no charge is made for settling the estate.

**Cash.** No cash patronage is carried into the settlement.

**The reckoning.** The discount acts on the equity standing and the discounted figure is rounded to two decimal places; the dividend is then worked out on that discounted figure, at the class's own dividend rate for each year carried, and rounded to two decimal places. The discounted equity, the dividend and the cash carried in are added; what is owed and the settlement charge are then taken off that sum; where the remainder would be less than nothing, nothing is settled; and the result is rounded to two decimal places. Every figure in this settlement is carried to two decimal places, a half cent rounding up.

## The sheet on hypothetical figures

| Line | Quantity | Figure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | equity portions credited on the allocation notices | 11800.00 |
| 2 | capital retains credited | 1640.00 |
| 3 | equity standing, lines 1 and 2 added, rounded | 13440.00 |
| 4 | the class's own estate retirement discount | 0 in the hundred |
| 5 | equity after the discount, rounded | 13440.00 |
| 6 | years of dividend carried | 0 |
| 7 | dividend on line 5, at the class's own dividend rate for each year carried, rounded | 0.00 |
| 8 | cash carried in | 0.00 |
| 9 | what is owed | 0.00 |
| 10 | settlement charge | 0.00 |
| 11 | lines 5, 7 and 8 added, lines 9 and 10 taken off, floored at nothing and rounded | 13440.00 |

The discount acts on the equity standing before the dividend is worked out, and the dividend is worked out on the discounted figure rather than on the equity standing.
